item.title: Pre-hospital air ambulance care boosts survival after major trauma
item.description: Air ambulance pre-hospital care (HEMS) may make surviving critical injury more likely as it's associated with saving 5 more lives than would be expected in every 100 major trauma cases, suggests an analysis of survival data for one regional service in South East England, and published online in Emergency Medicine Journal.

item.title: Breastfeeding and pregnancy linked to improved postmenopausal cognition
item.description: Female brains have historically evolved to adapt to pregnancy, undergoing structural and functional changes.

item.title: Engineered liver tissue model mimics early metabolic liver disease
item.description: More than 100 million people in the United States suffer from metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), characterized by a buildup of fat in the liver.

item.title: Ride Cincinnati grant funds research on immune activating wafer for glioblastoma treatment
item.description: A multidisciplinary team of University of Cincinnati Cancer Center researchers has received a $40,000 Ride Cincinnati grant to study a delayed release preparation, or wafer, of an immunostimulatory molecule to stimulate the central nervous system (CNS) immune system after surgery to remove glioblastoma, a form of primary brain cancer.

item.title: Common human fungus found to worsen melanoma aggressiveness
item.description: Cancer is one of the causes responsible for the most deaths worldwide; in 2020, for example, it resulted in ten million deaths. It has been estimated that micro-organism infections caused between 13-18% of these cases.

item.title: Trazodone linked to safer delirium outcomes in older adults
item.description: A large U.S. study suggests that older adults hospitalized with delirium may experience better outcomes when treated with trazodone, commonly used to treat depression and sleep problems, rather than commonly used antipsychotic medications.

item.title: Study links paid sick leave to lower infection risk
item.description: Home service workers-those who provide care, inspections, or repairs inside private homes-can often lack paid sick leave, making illness a direct financial risk.

item.title: Social media support may ease anxiety in young adults
item.description: Anxiety is the second leading cause of disability and mortality worldwide. Roughly a third of adults in the U.S. will experience an anxiety disorder within their lifetime, and the median age of onset is 17 years old.

item.title: Unusual i-DNA structure shown to regulate genes and cancer
item.description: DNA's iconic double helix does more than "just" store genetic information. Under certain conditions it can temporarily fold into unusual shapes.

item.title: Interpower® launches IEC 60320 rewirable Sheet E angled plug connector in black
item.description: Adding to its popular line of molded IEC 60320 appliance and interconnection couplers, Interpower announces the launch of its newly manufactured IEC 60320 rewirable Sheet E plug connector in an angled mount configuration initially offered in black.
